# Random Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Pixel Storm

**Concept:** Control a tiny ship that moves left/right at the bottom of the canvas, dodging falling pixel blocks. Tap to fire a short‑range EMP that clears nearby blocks. The game runs in an HTML canvas with simple sprite rendering and collision detection.

**Lose Condition:** The player loses if any falling block collides with the ship.
